content.text: Act as the exact-model independent post-freeze reviewer for c05 freeze commit 360a05b04f2c0ec7be544a731b7da2a1cf741503. Read docs/c05-supersession-preregistration.md, scripts/behavioral-parcour/c05-contract-files.json, docs/c05-evidence/raw-publication-ledger.json, scripts/behavioral-parcour/c05_runner.py, c05_scorer.py, c05_controller.py, c05_aggregate.py, verify_c05_freeze.py, every c05 test, the c04/c05 corpora, accepted Phase 0-B result and audit, and relevant frozen production files. This is an adversarial read-only review before preflight and before any prompt in the 56-cell schedule. Check exact identities; Phase 0 binding; only authorized scorer/corpus delta; default-off guard; structured-user causal fix; synthetic-message exclusion; telemetry; control predicate derived from before text; exact 8-smoke denominator with 4/4 positive fires and 0/4 controls; categorical matrix block; exact 48 order; no retries; mandatory stop classes; atomic ledger; raw evidence completeness; contract integrity; one-cell controller; and final uplift/control thresholds. Treat c01-c04 and Phase 0 attempt 1 as historical only. Do not infer from names. Output must begin exactly HEADLINE: PASS or HEADLINE: BLOCK. Next line exactly CONTRADICTS: ..., then NOT FOUND: ..., then BLOCKER: None or concrete blockers. Provide file:line citations for every material claim. A superficial PASS is failure; report every exploitable gap. Do not modify files or invoke Pi.
